Gamedevelopment.

Games bring design, technology, and storytelling into one active conversation. That mix keeps me curious.

game world03

Why it is a current focus.

I am interested in the way games teach through action. Every visual choice, rule, and bit of feedback can shape how a player understands a world.

Working with game concepts lets me explore interaction more playfully, while building skills I can carry into design and development projects beyond games.
